description:
The theme supplies two layout plugins.  

The first, **One column layout**, is a simple, full‑width arrangement categorized as *Basic*. Its description notes that it offers a single region that spans the entire width. The layout is rendered with the Twig template `templates/layouts/one-column.html.twig` and uses the default theme hook `layout`. All related assets are located under the path `layouts/one_column`; the associated library is `mytheme/one-column` and the preview icon is `icons/one-column.png`. The icon map contains a single entry mapping the “default” key to the same icon file. This layout defines one region named **content**, labelled “Content”, which is also the default region. The implementing class for this plugin is `Drupal\mytheme\Plugin\Layout\OneColumn`.  

The second, **Two column layout**, falls under the *Column* category and is described as a layout with left and right columns. It is rendered by the Twig file `templates/layouts/two-column.html.twig` and, like the first layout, relies on the default theme hook `layout`. Its resources live in `layouts/two_column`; the library is `mytheme/two-column` and the preview icon is `icons/two-column.png`. The icon map provides two mappings: “left” → `icons/left.png` and “right” → `icons/right.png`. This layout declares two regions—**left** and **right**—labelled “Left column” and “Right column”, respectively, with the left region set as the default. The plugin class responsible for this layout is `Drupal\mytheme\Plugin\Layout\TwoColumn`.
